expectations.text: Each brief has a narrow scope (one test file and the code it covers), a clear done-criterion (that test file passes) and the expected output format
expectations.evidence: Each brief limits edits to its own test file plus the source it tests ("Scope (may change)... `<path>/auth.test.js`... Auth source modules under test"). Each has a done criterion ("`<TEST_CMD> <path>/auth.test.js` exits 0 with all tests passing in a run made after your last edit") and a section head

expectations.text: The briefs tell each subagent what it must not change (other areas or the tests' assertions) and to report what it changed and why
expectations.evidence: Each brief marks everything else read-only ("Read-only. Everything else, especially shared test helpers, global config, and other modules such as `cart` and `search`") and allows a test-file change only when "a test asserts behaviour the code was intentionally changed away from, and say why in `deci
